subject.title: Reduce Vera TTS startup latency — begin speaking sooner after wake word / end of user turn

question: Should Android Talk Mode prioritize a single realtime relay path for low-latency speech, or should ordinary agent replies gain a new partial-text-to-TTS streaming contract?
rationale: The present final-event TTS path cannot meet the request by changing a buffer constant alone, and either streaming direction establishes cancellation, revision, and provider behavior that needs owner intent.

options.title: Measure then extend the realtime path
options.body: Instrument first-audio latency on a physical device and evolve the existing realtime relay only if its measured behavior does not satisfy the intended interactive experience.

options.title: Add partial-text TTS streaming
options.body: Define a gateway partial-output and cancellation contract for ordinary agent replies, with explicit handling for revisions, errors, and barge-in.

options.title: Keep final-only TTS
options.body: Retain current final-response synthesis and document that Talk Mode latency is provider/agent-bound rather than a streaming guarantee.

recommendation.title: Measure then extend the realtime path
recommendation.body: Instrument first-audio latency on a physical device and evolve the existing realtime relay only if its measured behavior does not satisfy the intended interactive experience.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent TalkModeManager playback-lifecycle work is the closest concrete history signal for the owner decision.
